display_decisions.current_financials: Only reviewed 30 Sep 2026 customer deposits and nine-month statutory pretax profit shown as current actuals. 2030 cost:income is visibly a target. No reconstructed current income, operating cost or revenue growth.
display_decisions.businesses: Customer/business roles and historic business-area labels are distinguished from current segment/legal-entity facts; no org-chart assertion.
display_decisions.brands: Lloyds/Halifax transition is supported by July 2026 announcement; delivery through 2027 not assumed complete. Bank of Scotland and Scottish Widows retained only as historic portfolio-brand references with current legal ownership unverified.
display_decisions.technology: Envoy/Google collaboration source supported; Vertex and model migration are older repository-reported context, not a verified current inventory.
display_decisions.customers: Household and business customer roles; no named corporate customer relationship.
display_decisions.regulators: BoE, PRA and FCA retain distinct roles. PRA shown as BoE prudential function, not a separate bank/company. Sector policy does not prove applicability to a Lloyds legal entity.
display_decisions.suppliers: Single named supported platform collaboration; no inferred exclusive contract, external scope or workshare.
display_decisions.visuals: AI-generated original conceptual architectural scenes; not evidence, real offices, actual campus topology, tenant or relative financial scale.
